mapper.sql: select b.id, b.name, b.is_leaf, b.status, b.del_flag, b.longitude, b.latitude, b.altitude, b.address, b.area, b.line, b.admin_dept, b.weight, b.video_feed, b.root_object_id, b.root_property_id, b.remark, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time from bi_building b
mapper.select: SELECT old_b.id, old_b.name, old_b.is_leaf, old_b.status, old_b.del_flag, old_b.longitude, old_b.latitude, old_b.altitude, old_b.address, old_b.area, old_b.line, old_b.admin_dept, old_b.weight, old_b.video_feed, old_b.root_object_id, old_b.root_property_id, old_b.remark, old_b.create_by, old_b.create_time, old_b.update_by, old_b.update_time FROM bi_building old_b INNER JOIN bi_building target_b ON target_b.del_flag = '0' AND target_b.line = #{targetLine} AND target_b.name = old_b.name AND target_b.area = old_b.area AND target_b.id != old_b.id WHERE old_b.del_flag = '0' AND old_b.line = #{originalLine} LIMIT 10
mapper.insert:
insert into bi_building
id, name, is_leaf, status, del_flag, longitude, latitude, altitude, address, area, line, admin_dept, weight, video_feed, root_object_id, root_property_id, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time,
#{id}, #{name}, #{isLeaf}, #{status}, #{delFlag}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{altitude}, #{address}, #{area}, #{line}, #{adminDept}, #{weight}, #{videoFeed}, #{rootObjectId}, #{rootPropertyId}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime},
mapper.update: update bi_building set line = #{targetLine}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where del_flag = '0' and line = #{originalLine}
update bi_building set root_object_id = #{rootObjectId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update bi_building set root_property_id = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where root_property_id = #{propertyId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.delete: update bi_building set del_flag = '1' where id = #{id}

update bi_building set del_flag = '1' where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.name, b.root_object_id FROM bi_building b JOIN bi_object o ON b.root_object_id = o.id WHERE o.parent_id = #{rootObjectId} AND b.del_flag = '0' AND o.del_flag = '0'

SELECT b.id, b.name, b.is_leaf, b.status, b.del_flag, b.longitude, b.latitude, b.altitude, b.address, b.area, b.line, b.admin_dept, b.weight, b.video_feed, b.root_object_id, b.root_property_id, b.remark, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, o.parent_id as parent_object_id, pb.id as parent_id, pb.name as parent_name FROM bi_building b LEFT JOIN bi_object o ON b.root_object_id = o.id LEFT JOIN bi_building pb ON pb.root_object_id = o.parent_id WHERE b.id = #{id} AND b.del_flag = '0'
select count(*) from bi_building where del_flag = '0'

select gps.id, gps.name, gps.is_leaf as isLeaf, gps.longitude, gps.latitude, ev.system_level as systemLevel, ev.system_score as systemScore, ev.superstructure_level as superstructureLevel, ev.substructure_level as substructureLevel, ev.deck_system_level as deckSystemLevel from ( select b.id, b.name, b.is_leaf, cast(max(lng.value) as decimal(12, 6)) as longitude, cast(max(lat.value) as decimal(12, 6)) as latitude from bi_building b inner join bi_property lng on lng.name = 'GPS经度' and substring_index(trim(both ',' from lng.ancestors), ',', 1) = b.root_property_id inner join bi_property lat on lat.name = 'GPS纬度' and substring_index(trim(both ',' from lat.ancestors), ',', 1) = b.root_property_id where b.del_flag = '0' and b.root_property_id is not null and lng.value regexp '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' and lat.value regexp '^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$' and cast(lng.value as decimal(12, 6)) between 73 and 136 and cast(lat.value as decimal(12, 6)) between 3 and 54 group by b.id, b.name, b.is_leaf ) gps left join ( select building_id, system_level, system_score, superstructure_level, substructure_level, deck_system_level from ( select t.building_id, e.system_level, e.system_score, e.superstructure_level, e.substructure_level, e.deck_system_level, row_number() over (partition by t.building_id order by e.update_time desc, e.id desc) as rn from bi_evaluation e inner join bi_task t on t.id = e.task_id and t.del_flag = '0' ) ranked where rn = 1 ) ev on ev.building_id = gps.id order by gps.name
